text:
Ravi N: Heads-up  were putting together a Trainer Lab Playbook for SI partners — goal is a 90-minute hands-on lab + 30-min teardown and ops checklist. Need input on safe sample data and hardware partner notes.

Ella T: Love it. Can we make the lab reproducible in both AWS and partner-prem? Minimal infra: 1 GPU instance, ephemeral S3 bucket, and a mock dataset.

Dmitri V: For partner-prem we should include a 'no-PII' redaction step and sample sed/awk commands for log scrubbing. Also include how to rotate service keys.

Karen H: Re: certs, if we make the lab mandatory for 'Certified Trainer' badge, we need an automated grading script. I can sketch a pytest-based validator that checks outputs against golden prompts.

Ravi N: That would be great. Keep grading tolerant to minor generation variance (fuzzy matching). Also include a checklist for KMS usage when demonstrating private deploys.

Ella T: Quick idea: provide a tiny dataset generator so trainers don't have to upload real customer data. One CLI to generate 10 example records.

Dmitri V: Agreed. CLI example: `python tools/gen_sample.py --seed demo --count 10`. Put that in the instructor kit.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: marketplace listings require 3 screenshots (UI, deployment success, logs), a 300-word overview, and an icon 128x128. See https://marketplace.redwood/docs/listing-requirements.

Karen H: For the teardown play, include stop/start commands and a one-liner to wipe state. Candidate snippet:
```
# stop services
kubectl scale deployment/redwood-lab --replicas=0
# remove ephemeral bucket
aws s3 rb s3://redwood-si-lab-<id> --force
```

Ravi N: Also include a backup note: if customer wants to keep outputs, trainers MUST copy artifacts to S3 before teardown. Add a consent checkbox in the trainer guide.

Ella T: Ops escalation: add a list of contacts by region and expected SLAs. Keep it short: Primary (on-call), Secondary (partner-eng), Escalation (Jeff on duty).

Dmitri V: We should version lab scripts and tag releases so partners can pin to a stable lab image. Add an example gitflow section: `lab-v1.0`, `lab-v1.1-patch`.

Ravi N: Good call. Marco from marketplace can we get an example listing YAML included in the kit? Need fields for sku, pricing_tier, regions, and support_email.

marketplace-bot: Sample YAML required. Example:
```
sku: redwood-si-trainer-basic
pricing_tier: free-trial
regions:
  - us-west-2
support_email: si-partners@redwood.ai
```

Karen H: Risk note: do not include real API keys or PII in screenshots. Provide redaction instructions (blur tool recommended) and a sample redacted screenshot.

Ella T: I'll draft the Quickstart (5 slides), the lab script repo (runnable), and a short troubleshooting FAQ for common container / permission errors.

Dmitri V: I'll build the pytest validator and the sample data generator. Will add fuzzy-match thresholds as config.

Ravi N: I'll own the teardown checklist and the consent checkbox text. Also will run a dry-run with one SI next week.

Karen H: I'll wire the cert badge criteria to the LMS and add a 30-question online exam as a gate. Passing threshold proposal: 80% for Certified Trainer.

Ravi N: Let's sync Fri 11am PT for 20 mins to review artifacts. I'll post a calendar invite.

Ella T: Ack :thumbsup:

Dmitri V: Ack — pushing initial code to feature/si-lab-playbook by Thursday.

marketplace-bot: Ticket PART-9002 created: "SI Trainer Lab Playbook and marketplace listing samples" assigned to @Ravi N, due 2024-05-10.
